args: Poprawki JP 2026-11-01. Klatki 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 są dobre — zostaw je bez zmian. Frame 2 must have the eyes OPEN (only a gentle breath in, chest slightly raised); only frame 3 blinks. Frame 7 flying straight UP: whole body stretched vertically, both front paws straight up ABOVE THE HEAD, tail hanging down, feet pointing down. Frame 8 top of the jump: curled into a compact ball, knees pulled up under the chin, front paws hugging the knees, eyes closed with joy. Frames 9 and 10 falling: both front paws raised high above the head, ears and tail blown upwards, legs dangling below, surprised open mouth; 10 slightly lower paws than 9. Every frame faces RIGHT (nose to the right edge, tail on the left).
